title: Louie
requirements: Comprehensive character and asset creation across a multi-year partnership. Projects ranged from creating base protagonist figures modeled after triple-A fantasy archetypes with separate, modular hair/beard assets, to crafting intricate dark warrior and goddess armor sets. The contract also covered shader setup, alpha cutout maps for glowing segments, and extensive material node optimizations.
achievements: Supplied fully modular outfits with interchangeable mesh layers for dynamic visual adjustments
Configured sophisticated PBR materials with custom lighting nodes for crystal-emission highlights
Authored extensive technical documentation enabling seamless in-engine materials configuration
